target_customer: Frontier AI labs that buy expert reasoning data for model training and evaluation
problem: Frontier models saturate existing benchmarks, so labs need fresh, expert written math and physics problems they cannot yet solve.
business_model: Data sales to AI labs: custom problem sets and continuous data streams written by Olympiad level experts
product_category: Expert STEM training and evaluation data

founders.name: Osman Siddique
founders.background_notes: International Physics Olympiad 2022 medalist and two time highest national scorer.

competitors.name: Mercor
competitors.what: Marketplace paying vetted experts to write, grade and check training data
competitors.traction_then: Reported about 500M annualized revenue by August 2025 (secondary sources)
competitors.funding_then: Reported 350M Series C at 10B in October 2025

competitors.name: Handshake AI
competitors.what: Network of STEM experts for AI training data
competitors.traction_then: CEO said demand tripled after Meta's Scale AI deal

competitors.name: Turing
competitors.what: Sells expert STEM data packs in math, physics, chemistry and biology to frontier labs
competitors.traction_then: Describes itself as a data partner to all frontier labs

technical_complexity.rationale: Core difficulty is recruiting elite problem writers and quality control, not software; a small team can run it with standard tooling.

defensibility.rationale: Access to Olympiad medalists is a differentiator, but large funded vendors recruit similar experts and labs can multi source.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded vendors were already selling expert STEM data in 2025; Meta's Scale AI stake pushed labs toward neutral vendors, widening the market.

market_need_then: Labs shifted demand toward STEM experts in 2025 and reportedly pay over 125 USD per hour per Handshake's CEO; frontier models scoring near zero on the hardest problems is the company's own claim.

identity.voice_and_tone: Bold, expertise focused: The hardest problems, built by the best minds

branding.brand_signature: Credential led positioning with Olympiad medalists

brand_strength.rationale: Clear credential driven voice on its site, but no press or community coverage of the brand found.

outcome_analysis: Sciloop is a Fall 2025 YC company, Active with a team of six, selling Olympiad level math and physics problems to AI labs. No customers are named and funding figures vary by aggregator, so traction is unverified. It enters a market where Mercor, Handshake, Turing and Surge were already large, so its edge depends on elite problem quality.
notes: Funding unverified and conflicting: about 500K (Neuronfeed, VCBacked, Dec 2025), 130K YC seed in Sept 2025 (aggregator), 1M total with The E14 Fund (Caplight); none recorded as rounds. YC launch post describes a different product (AI that automates research), a possible later positioning shift. Competitor sources are undated 2025 articles, so source_date is the year only. Team size 6 on directory vs 2 on one aggregator. Update: the 500K pre-seed dated 2025-12 is recorded from VCBacked only (single database). A 130K YC seed in 2025-09 and a 1M total with The E14 Fund (Caplight) conflict and are not recorded; search results did not name E14 as an investor.
